en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal fishing town with wooden boats moored in a calm harbor. On the right are wooden piers and boathouses built over the water; in the background steep rocky cliffs rise behind clusters of traditional wooden houses. A tall church with a pointed steeple stands on the left side of the town. The word "FJÄLLBACKA" is printed in white in the lower left corner, and there is a triangular publisher's logo with the number 1222 in the lower right.
